newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells HRK40 mln 91-day T-bills, rate rises.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells HRK40 mln 91-day T-bills, rate rises.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday it raised 40 million kuna through 91-day treasury bills.
The accepted rate rose to 13 percent, from 9.5 percent three weeks ago. The issue was priced at 96.861 kuna after bidders offered as low as 96.627.
The bills are payable on October 10 and they mature on January 9, 1997.
Bids totalled 46.3 million kuna at 9.50-14.0 percent rates. The weighted average was 12.33 percent.

The ministry will next auction 120 million kuna worth of 35-day T-bills, issued at 11 percent last week, on October 22. The auctions are not open to foreigners. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
